intro: Look at what changes. Nothing is applied until you confirm.
alreadyApplied: The changes had already been applied. Nothing was applied a second time.
discarded: The changes were discarded. Nothing was modified.
noEffects: This change has no other effects.

errors.unknownKind: This kind of change cannot be previewed.
errors.discarded: This proposal was already discarded. Nothing was modified.
errors.expired: The proposal has expired. Make the change again to see an up-to-date preview.
errors.alreadyApplied: The changes have already been applied and can no longer be undone from here.
errors.stale: Something changed in the meantime and the preview is out of date. Make the change again.
